newsitem.title: SPAIN: GOLF-MCNULTY WINS VOLVO MASTERS BY SEVEN SHOTS.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-MCNULTY WINS VOLVO MASTERS BY SEVEN SHOTS.

text.p: Mark McNulty cantered to a seven-shot victory in the Volvo Masters at Valderrama on Sunday.
He finished with a three-under-par round of 68 and collected a first prize of $240,000 which boosted him to fifth on the European money list.
The Zimbabwean won from a quartet comprising Jose Coceres of Argentina, South African Wayne Westner and Britons Lee Westwood and Sam Torrance.

Injured Australian Robert Allenby, who struck just one shot in Thursday's opening round in a bid to preserve third place in Tour earnings, remained in that position and collected a $116,500 bonus. He said he would donate it to two children's charities.
